title: Dormant H264 encoder descriptors
summary: Adds dormant H.264/NVENC and libx264 encoder descriptors plus direct descriptor-flag guards without activating H.264 routing through the descriptor resolver.
reason: Continue the encoder-breadth descriptor migration toward x264/NVENC coverage while preserving Phase 0 encode-argument parity and keeping unsupported HDR H.264 paths fail-closed until real preservation behavior is designed and validated.
behavior_before: The descriptor catalog described only the active HEVC/NVENC and libx265 parity paths. H.264 choices always fell through the legacy branch and no descriptor-level H.264 shape or HDR guard existed.
behavior_after: The descriptor catalog includes dormant H.264/NVENC and libx264 descriptors with SDR profile flags and explicit HDR10 preservation rejection, while Resolve-MediaEncoderDescriptorForFlags still returns null for H.264 choices so existing pipeline behavior and snapshots stay unchanged.
manual_validation: pwsh -NoProfile -File ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1 - passed (22 encode snapshots unchanged; dormant H.264 descriptor guards passed)
rollback_plan: Revert MP-CHANGE-2026-0619-041 to remove the dormant H.264 descriptor entries, direct descriptor guards, related assertions, generated summaries, and documentation status updates. No runtime state or media files are mutated by this change.
notes:
